title: Short but genuine answers cannot be quoted: the strict verifier's 12-code-point / 2-token minimum turns 'Yes.', 'In March.' or 'Friday.' into an unanswered Q&A
evidence: In the drop path an answer whose only evidence is a quote under 12 code points or 2 tokens is refused (`too-short`), so the entry is emitted as `unanswered` with null answer. The schema's own fixture (schema/fixtures/session_pages/valid-grounded.json) uses the answer 'In March.' (9 chars), which this path could never emit as answered. Safe direction (no fake evidence) but loses real answers. Policy owner decision: allow a short quote only when it equals a whole turn, or accept the loss. Not changed here (the verifier is merged, checked code).

title: Verified quotes can still drop a negation or qualifier: the sentence-span rule the verifier manifest says a wiring unit must add is NOT enforced
evidence: qa/manifests/t040-strict-quote-verifier-and-windowing.md (Fix cycle 1, 'READ THIS FIRST' point 2) says a wiring unit must require the quote to span a whole sentence/clause or display the surrounding sentence. This unit does not: 'I do not think it is safe' can be emitted as an insight whose verified quote is 'think it is safe'. Mitigation present: every item is labelled verification 'unverified' and the independent judge sees the full adjacent context and rejects unsupported/miscategorised items, but the judge is a model. Needs a policy decision (sentence-aligned quotes only, vs. showing the surrounding turn at render time via the cited turnId). CHECKER REPRODUCTION (end to end, fake model, dropUnverified+strictWebinar, judge passing everything): source turn t1 "We do not recommend applying in March"; model item {kind:insight,text:"recommend applying in March",evidence:[{t1,"recommend applying in March"}]} SHIPS: citedItems[0].text and evidence quote both "recommend applying in March", dropped=[], degraded=null. The text==quotes rule (extractiveText) only compares the item text with its own quotes, so an extractive item whose quote omits the negation passes it; the opposite-meaning statement is emitted with a verbatim, verifier-passed citation. Same for "I do not think it is safe to wait" -> "think it is safe to wait" (2 of 2 shipped). A paraphrase text ("Apply in March") is dropped, so the exposure is exactly the verbatim-fragment case. Raised to high by the checker: a wrong-meaning citation is shipped as evidence; the only guard is a model judge.

title: A quote that straddles a 4000-character span cut, or sits in a cut word, is dropped (false drop)
evidence: runtimeWindows slices an oversized turn into 4000-char spans at arbitrary offsets. The drop path requires the quote to lie entirely inside one submitted span and to start/end at word boundaries, so a sentence crossing a cut can never be emitted from that turn. Fail-closed, only for turns over 4000 chars. Not changed (windowing is merged, checked code).

title: The roadmap's 'numbers' have no category: CitedItem.kind is insight|decision|action and no field carries numbers
evidence: T-040 asks for summary, facts, numbers, Q&A, action items. The merged schema has no number kind; numeric statements ride as insights (citedItems) or claims, and session_pages.numericFacts is an untouched free-form legacy array. Not invented here; a schema decision for the Approver.

title: dropUnverified is not switched on by any caller; the live webinar runner is untouched (D-119) and process-video buildNotes still returns empty decisions/actions
evidence: indexSession accepts `dropUnverified` (with strictWebinar) but apps/api/src/composition/production.ts buildIndexer and scripts/webinar/sync-session.mjs do not pass it, so no production path uses the drop mode yet. ISS-WEBINARRELEASE-001's first recorded reproduction (scripts/webinar/process-video.mjs buildNotes returns decisions:[] and actionItems:[]) is therefore NOT addressed by this unit.
